beats.say: Hello! In this lesson you will learn to spot fake shops on social media.
Look at this ad: an expensive air conditioner for only 299 manat, today only, paid in advance.

body.text: Air conditioner for just 299 AZN, not 1,199!

beats.say: The scammer takes the money first, then closes the page and disappears.
The rule is simple: never prepay an unknown page, and pay on delivery whenever you can.

scenes.prompt: Which shop offer is safe and which is a threat?

body.text: The offer ends today, only 3 left. Payment by card to card only, 100% in advance.

cards.explain: Pressure plus card to card prepayment only is the main sign of a fake shop. That money is very hard to get back.

body.text: Air conditioner 1,149 AZN. Pay on delivery, cash or card. Shop and service centre in Narimanov.

cards.explain: A realistic price, a page that is years old and payment on delivery. You see the goods first and pay after.
This is not the shop's official site. An extra word added to the name and a strange domain mark a fake page.

body.text: Hi! I send orders with CevikKargo, you pay the courier when it arrives.

cards.explain: Paying on delivery protects you. You never pay before you see the goods.

body.text: Our page is new but we have 20k followers. We closed comments to stop spam. Send a 50 AZN deposit.

cards.explain: A new page, closed comments and a deposit request together are a serious warning. Followers can be bought.

scenes.title: Air conditioner offer
scenes.intro: You saw a cheap air conditioner ad on Kontakto. Decide step by step on your phone.

body.text: Air conditioner for just 299 AZN, not 1,199! Today only, 100% prepayment.

steps.say: The ad is very tempting. Looking is fine.

actions.label: Open the ad
actions.feedback: Looking is not dangerous. The real decision comes before you pay.

actions.label: Hide ad
actions.feedback: Good choice. A price that is far too low is often bait.

body.text: Hi! The offer ends today at 18:00.
Send your name and address and transfer 299 AZN to this card: **** **** **** 0000. Delivery tomorrow.

steps.say: The seller asks for prepayment straight away.

actions.label: Can I pay on delivery?
actions.feedback: Good question. A real shop usually agrees to payment on delivery.

actions.label: Transfer 299 AZN now
actions.feedback: The money went to a stranger's card. A prepayment is very hard to get back.

actions.label: Report page
actions.feedback: Well done. The page you reported cannot fool other buyers.

body.text: No payment on delivery at the sale price. Send at least a 50 AZN deposit and pay the rest to the courier.

steps.say: Here comes the excuse: now it wants a deposit.

actions.label: Send 50 AZN deposit
actions.feedback: A deposit is a prepayment too. The fake shop takes it and vanishes.

actions.label: Find the shop's official page myself
actions.feedback: Right. Checking the official page and buyer reviews takes a few minutes.

actions.label: Block
actions.feedback: Good. A stranger who will not sell without prepayment is not worth the talk.

body.text: Serin Klimat Sale was deleted or has blocked you.

steps.say: The next day no air conditioner came, and the page is gone.

actions.label: Call the bank on the number on the card
actions.feedback: Right. If the bank hears quickly, it can try to stop the transfer.

actions.label: Save screenshots, tell the police
actions.feedback: Good step. The chat and the transfer receipt are evidence for the police.

actions.label: Wait a few days
actions.feedback: Every hour counts. Waiting lowers the chance of getting the money back.

body.text: Hello! This is our only official page. Air conditioner 1,149 AZN, pay on delivery in cash or by card.
Any page asking for prepayment in our name is not ours.

steps.say: This is the shop's official page.

actions.label: Order with payment on delivery
actions.feedback: Great choice. You pay after you see and check the goods.

actions.label: Show the shop the fake page
actions.feedback: Good. The shop can report the fake page and get it taken down.

actions.label: Go back to the cheap page
actions.feedback: Going back to the fake page puts your money at risk. Stay with the official shop.

scenes.prompt: Match each sign with what it means.

pairs.right: Fake shops open fast and close fast
The money is very hard to recover

pairs.left: Price is a third of the market

scenes.explain: One sign is enough to stop. Check the shop on its official site and in buyer reviews.

question.prompt: You are buying from an online shop you do not know. What is the safest way to pay?

options.label: Pay on delivery, when you get the goods
options.feedback: Right. You never pay before you see the goods, so a fake shop gets nothing.

options.label: Transfer to the seller's personal card
options.feedback: A transfer to a personal card cannot be reversed. That is exactly what scammers want.

options.label: Send half as a deposit
options.feedback: A deposit is a prepayment too. The fake shop takes it and vanishes.

options.label: Pay with cryptocurrency
options.feedback: Nobody can reverse a crypto transfer. If a shop asks for it, walk away.

scenes.explain: If prepayment is required, pay only an official shop you have known for a long time. When in doubt, do not buy.

points: Never prepay a page you do not know.
Pay on delivery when you can: see the goods first, then pay.
Check the page's age and reviews, and do not trust a price that is far too low.
